description:
Search the available computational nodes by task, name, or category. Results are
        paginated (limit 1 to 100, offset starting at 0); follow next_offset when has_more is true.
        Search for "fft", "smooth a noisy signal", or a protocol name to check actual availability.
        Example: list_node_types(search="websocket") or list_node_types(search="smooth a noisy signal", limit=10).

category.description: Only node types of this category (as list_node_types reports it). Empty for all.
category.title: Category

offset.description: Index of the first result; use next_offset from the previous page.
offset.title: Offset

search.description: Words to search for in names, purposes and categories, e.g. fft, smooth a noisy signal, modbus.
search.title: Search

name: list_node_types
title: List node types
